notablePrerequisites:
"Skeleton" or "Warrior" chosen with Reflections of Littjara.
An opponent has lost life this turn.
description:
Cast Gutterbones by paying {B}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, creating a token copy of Gutterbones.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gutterbones and the Gutterbones token, adding {2}.
The Gutterboness die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Gutterbones by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
